question: The internet works by using a protocol called TCP/IP. What is the full form of TCP/IP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol**__.

__
 
• **TCP/IP stands for Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol**__.

 __
 
• TCP/IP is a set of standardized rules that allow computers to communicate on a network such as an internet.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **The Internet Protocol Suite**, commonly known as TCP/IP, is the set of communication protocols used in the Internet and similar computer networks.

 
 
• The current basic protocols in the suite are Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and Internet Protocol (IP).
 
 
 
• **Web browser or Internet browser,** the browser is a software program for rendering and exploring content on the World Wide Web.
 
 
• These pieces of content, including images, videos, and web pages, are linked using hyperlinks and classified with URIs (Uniform Resource Identifiers).
 
• This page is an example of a web page that can be viewed using a browser.
